body: I keep my eyes on the dog, its tail wagging lazily as it approaches me. It looks friendly, and I can't shake the feeling that it's watching me with an unnerving intensity. I step back, trying to make myself look as small and non-threatening as possible. I can't help but wonder if someone's been feeding these dogs, maybe as a joke or to help them out. My mind starts racing with the thought of reporting this to the depot authorities. I take a few cautious steps forward, my hand resting on the door handle of the depot, prepared to bolt the moment I feel the familiar click of the door's locking mechanism.
